scope: Plan and offline request preparation only; no generation authorized by this artifact
research_question: With identical FULL source context, do explicit modality-preservation instructions and an additional proposition self-check instruction improve explanation completeness?

arm_definition.A0_BASE: Exact prior FULL/NONE request, generated anew

output_policy: Identical prior JSON schema and explanation_ko 2-4 sentences in all arms; no observable checklist field, extra model call, retrieval, external tool or post-generation repair
execution_order: Sort slots by SHA256(seed + slot_id); sequential fresh requests without conversation state
replicate_interpretation: Two identical-input calls per case/arm; pairing uses case and replicate index, not a shared model random seed; three source cases, not six independent cases
reservation_method: For each request: (UTF8 input bytes + compact JSON schema bytes + 2048 overhead allowance) * input unit price + max_output_tokens * output unit price. Planning allowance, not a provider-enforced billing cap; no cache discount assumed.
retry_policy: No automatic retry or selective regeneration. Stop on uncertain transport, HTTP error, missing/invalid usage or model mismatch. Preserve attempted and unattempted slots and any unknown cost.
delivery_policy: Empty/refused/truncated/schema-invalid completed response is task-completeness 0 with distinct delivery status. Unattempted/uncertain-transport slots are NOT_OBSERVED; interrupted run cannot pass the progression gate. Non-delivery claims are NOT_ASSESSABLE, not a zero-distortion success.
semantic_evaluation: Copy the prior frozen assessment surface, compound requirement and ambiguity rules. Evaluate explanation_ko against the same nine requirements across three cases; metadata/citation diagnostics separate. Preserve null and full quotations/rationales.
review_plan: Two AI reviewers in separate contexts, each scoring all 18 anonymized responses without arm labels, prompts, old scores, other judgments or aggregate results. Seal each set before comparison. Source + question + requirements + output supplied. Imperfect blinding; no human expert or statistical independence claim.
inference_policy: Descriptive counts, unresolved bounds and case/replicate transitions only; no p-values, confidence intervals or generalization claims. Two reviewer records of one response are not two generated samples.

progression_gate.scope: Conservative engineering screen for proceeding to an unseen-clause extension; not statistical evidence
all_required: All 18 slots have usable explanations; both review sets are sealed; source bindings and output accounting pass
For each reviewer, confirmed complete count A2 exceeds confirmed complete plus unresolved count A0
For each reviewer, confirmed distorted plus unresolved-claim count A2 does not exceed confirmed distorted count A0
For each reviewer, no paired A0 completeness=1 becomes A2 completeness=0 or null
For each reviewer, at least one paired 0-to-1 gain occurs in STORAGE_RECOMMENDATION or LOCATION_UNLESS_RECOMMENDATION, and at least one in EMERGENCY_EXCEPTION or ECALL_EXCEPTION
progression_gate.pass: READY_FOR_UNSEEN_CLAUSE_PLAN; requires separate clause selection, source review and freeze before any extension calls
progression_gate.otherwise: HOLD_FOR_METHOD_REVISION; report all arms and disagreements, do not select A1 as an unregistered winner or tune/retry within v1

stage_2.candidate_target: 12 new non-overlapping clauses, 6 modality strata with 2 clauses each; each includes an explicit condition/exception or scoped capability proposition
stage_2.design: 12 clauses x same 3 frozen arms x 2 repeats = 72 calls; separate cohort
stage_2.selection: After method freeze, inventory sources without model generations; exclude prior 72 cases, all development cases, shared normative paragraph/context spans, and manually identified semantic duplicates. Log all candidates and exclusions. Seeded hash selection within strata; no replacement after observing outputs.
stage_2.budget: Not included in the $0.50 development cap; estimate and freeze a separate budget after source selection
stage_2.insufficient_candidates: HOLD and amend source selection before generation; do not relax novelty/overlap rules silently
stage_2.limits: Held out from this project's prompt development only, not model pretraining. Twelve purposively constrained clauses are not a representative 3GPP benchmark. Source IDs, requirements and budget remain unfrozen.
